channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Better Fruit Press
item.description: Makes the fruit press quicker and allows squeezing over barrels.

item.title: Feral Kinship: Companions
item.description: Turns tamed foxes into full companions with perks, moods, packs, expeditions, and more.

item.title: Riley's Classes
item.description: Addon for Aldi's Classes, makes classes interact with other mods and adds new ones!

item.title: Tandem Waterwheel Fix
item.description: Fixes tandem water wheel reversal and explains how to divert rapid water.

item.title: Daubious Savings
item.description: Halves the amount of raw daub needed to make the initial wattle and daub and adds grid recipes.

item.title: Bear Bones
item.description: Repair your bear hide armour with bones and rope.

item.title: Hemp To Flax
item.description: A somewhat simple mod that allows you to swap grassroots hemp with flax

item.title: Size To Health Bonus
item.description: HP scales with your Player Model Lib size — bigger = tougher, smaller = weaker. Configurable.

item.title: Recipe Designer
item.description: Design crafting recipes from an in-game menu! Modding utility.

item.title: The Mighty Walnut
item.description: Adding walnuts as a food source and slightly worse alternative to peanuts

item.title: Veganized
item.description: Plants make the real vanilla fat, wax and bone meal, so every recipe that wants them just works.

item.title: Traders Expansion
item.description: 6 new traders and ways to make money

item.title: Bikini Bear
item.description: Every bear has a 10% chance to spawn in a pink polka-dot bikini. All 5 species. No explanations.

item.title: Specialized Storage Renewed
item.description: A fork of SpecializedBags Revived with a few things from BackPackPlus for my personal server.

item.title: Orca Player Model With Clothes
item.description: Adds a variant of orcafolks to the main mod that displays clothing

item.title: Rapid Guard
item.description: Place a cobble top slab on in rapid water sources at worldgen to protect from soil instability

item.title: Container Searcher
item.description: Search nearby inventories for whatever item you're hovering over

item.title: Eternal Stew x XSkills-Fork
item.description: Eternal Stew actions give Cooking EXP and use Cooking Skill Buffs!

item.title: Rapids In Bucket
item.description: Allows you to pick up and place rapids with bucket

item.title: Dyed Wood
item.description: Adds dyed planks, slabs, and stairs for every vanilla wood while preserving natural grain.

item.title: Eternal Stew x Hydrate or Dydrate Compatibility
item.description: Ingredient-based hydration compatibility between Eternal Stew and Hydrate Or Diedrate.

item.title: Primitive Survival
item.description: Fishing, trapping, irrigation, smoker, nightcrawlers, snakes, and much more!

item.title: DesertWearPatch
item.description: Patches in recipes for DesertWear.

item.title: Stacked Gates
item.description: Fence gates stacked on top of each other open and close together. Server-side only.

item.title: More Blood Thingies!
item.description: Adds all the features for bloodbread that should have been.

item.title: Stats Breakdown
item.description: Displays a breakdown of player stats on hover

item.title: Isometric Renders
item.description: High resolution orthographic and isometric renders for Vihntage Story worlds, structures and objects

item.title: Dar's Server Utilities
item.description: Combines my mods with the intent to be used specifically on Sundered Isles Server

item.title: AstraTerra
item.description: Turns the night sky into an dynamic starfield, create and monitor your own constellations.

item.title: Grid for Beams
item.description: Adds a grid for beams and shows the cube where the beam's hitbox will be when placed.
